title: pvMinkowskiFilter
body:
## pvMinkowskiFilter

Computes Minkowski functionals and shapefinders for each polyhedral cell of a Voronoi tessellation (vtkMinkowskiFilter). It adds cell arrays S (surface area), V (volume, copied from the input's Volumes array), C (integrated mean curvature), X (Euler characteristic), G (genus), T = 3V/S (thickness), B = S/C (breadth), L = C/(4 pi (G + 1)) (length), and planarity P and filamentarity F, which characterize whether a structure is sheet-like or filament-like. Use it on merged Voronoi regions from pvVoronoiMergeConnected.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Every cell must be a polyhedron and the input must have a Volumes cell array; other unstructured grids are not handled by the native code.
- Lengths and areas are in the dataset's coordinate units; no conversion is applied.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `MinkowskiFilter`. Identity: `filters/MinkowskiFilter`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

ParaView: This property specifies the input for this filter. Accepted data: unstructured grids (vtkUnstructuredGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkUnstructuredGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
